title: Flowise is shutting down
summary: Flowise, a popular open-source no-code platform for building LLM applications using LangChain, has officially announced its shutdown. The project, which provided a visual drag-and-drop interface for creating AI workflows, has ceased operations and its community is now migrating to alternative solutions.
problem_solved: It democratized AI application development by enabling non-developers to build LLM-powered workflows without writing code.
why_valuable: This announcement marks the end of a widely-used open-source AI tool, signaling consolidation in the AI tooling space and prompting the community to explore alternative platforms.
